source_observations: sScrollDistances has only the three named 0/1/2 entries, with values 1/2/4; FontFunc_Braille indexes it directly from the 3-bit saved option at lines 165, 172 and 173.
ScrCmd_braillemessage passes printer speed 0 and does not call GetTextSpeedSetting. The examined new-game and normal options-menu writers constrain ordinary values to 0-2.

The save-sector reader validates checksums and copies accepted bytes without an optionsTextSpeed-specific semantic check. A checksum-valid externally altered field value 3 is an adversarial source-level input; this does not establish that an unmodified stock path generates or executes it.

A temporary host sanitizer harness using the unchanged source body produced a bounds diagnostic for optionsTextSpeed 3 at line 165. This is conditional on the supplied state and is not evidence that malformed state is reachable in ordinary gameplay.
DecompressGlyph_Braille derives its asset pointer from glyph without a local range check; all authored glyph IDs and the generated asset extent were not enumerated.
The pinned PNG is 256x64 with a 2-bit colormap; its nominal 16x16 grid has 64 cells, but the generated compressed font and exact runtime pointer extent were not built or verified.
objections_and_unresolved: No proof that a checksum-valid externally altered speed value 3 is accepted through every complete game-load path and later reaches the Braille scroll state; that end-to-end sequence was not executed.
The source-level load path verifies sector checksums, not the semantic range of optionsTextSpeed; normal stock writers nevertheless produce only 0-2.
The generated braille.fwjpnfont size/encoding and full authored glyph-ID range remain unverified; source pointer arithmetic has no local glyph bound check.
Script message pointer validity, string termination, all call ordering and all authored script data remain unresolved; the overlapping script files are not treated as newly reviewed.
The host harness uses synthetic GBA structure/header stubs and mocked window/decompression calls; it proves neither target ABI correctness nor target execution.

licensing.basis: Pinned upstream root listing has no LICENSE file; pinned README identity is recorded but does not establish a license.

fault_control.expected: UBSan index 3 out of bounds or ASan global-buffer-overflow at src/braille_text.c:165
fault_control.interpretation: Explicitly injected invalid state only; this control is not evidence of ordinary stock reachability.

source_mutation_control.temporary_mutation: Replace all three sScrollDistances[gSaveBlock2Ptr->optionsTextSpeed] reads with sScrollDistances[OPTIONS_TEXT_SPEED_MID].
source_mutation_control.expected: PASS; no sanitizer bounds diagnostic and expected fixed scroll delta 2.

host_validation.limitations: Harness stubs are synthetic and the mutation is created only in a temporary directory. The test does not execute the generated font, GBA ABI, ARM code, save loader or emulator.
